zh: a live exchange of messages using the internet
en: a live exchange of messages using the internet
ex: In a web chat with fans, the singer revealed that her new album would be called ‘Lemonade’.
在与歌迷的网络聊天中，这位歌手透露她的新专辑将被称为“柠檬水”。

zh: 虚拟主机服务；网站托管；网页寄存
en: the activity or business of providing space to store websites, access to them and other services related to them
ex: If you are starting your own business you can buy affordable web hosting or host your own website.
如果自己创业，你可以购买负担得起的虚拟主机或自行存储网站。

en: a document that is connected to the World Wide Web and that anyone with an internet connection can see, usually forming part of a website
ex: We learned how to create and register a new web page.
我们学会了如何制作和注册一个新网页。

en: a bird or an animal (such as a duck or frog) that has webbed feet has pieces of skin between the toes

zh: （用以制作带子等的）带状结实织物
en: strong, narrow pieces of cloth that are used to make belts, etc., and to support the seats of chairs, etc.

zh: 网络摄像机；网络摄影机；网路摄影头
en: a video camera that is connected to a computer so that what it records can be seen on a website or on another computer as it happens
a live broadcast that is sent out on the internet
ex: We were able to watch a live webcast of the eclipse.
我们得以观看了日食的网络直播。

zh: a series of comic strips (= drawings inside boxes that tell a story) that are published on the internet
en: a series of comic strips (= drawings inside boxes that tell a story) that are published on the internet
ex: It's a new webcomic about a school for the kids of superheroes.
这是关于一所面向超级英雄孩子的学校的新网络漫画。

en: a unit for measuring the amount of magnetic force that passes through a point in a magnetic field
a presentation or seminar (= a meeting for discussion or training) that is conducted over the internet
ex: Our company uses webinars to train representatives in other countries.
我们公司用网上研讨会的方式对派驻其他国家的销售代表进行培训。

zh: 网络剧集；网络短视频（用于宣传电影、电视节目、音乐视频等）
en: an episode (= one part) of a television series that is available only on the internet; a short video on the internet used to promote a film, television programme, music video, etc.

zh: a website where an individual person, or people representing an organization, write regularly about recent events or topics that interest them, usually with photos and links to other websites that they find interesting
en: a website where an individual person, or people representing an organization, write regularly about recent events or topics that interest them, usually with photos and links to other websites that they find interesting

zh: （万维网）站点管理员，网络管理员
en: a person who is responsible for particular pages of information on the World Wide Web
a set of pages on the internet, where a company or an organization, or an individual person, puts information
ex: For current prices please visit our website.
有关目前的价格，请访问我们的网站。

en: a magazine published on the internet, not on paper
to marry
ex: The couple plan to wed next summer.
这俩人计划在夏天结婚。

en: Wednesday
if you are wedded to something, you like or support it so much that you are not willing to give it up
ex: She's wedded to her job.
她专心致志地工作。

en: a marriage ceremony, and the meal or party that usually follows it
ex: I dreamed of having a big wedding, with all my family and friends.
我梦想着与我的家人和朋友一起举行一场大型婚礼。

en: the celebration every year of the date when two people were married
ex: Today's our wedding anniversary.
今天是我们的结婚纪念日。

zh: 结婚戒指（通常为金质净面）
en: a ring, usually in the form of a plain gold band, that is given during a marriage ceremony and worn afterwards to show that you are married
ex: She had a plain wedding band on her third finger.
她无名指上戴着一枚很普通的结婚戒指。

en: a special meal after a marriage ceremony
a special cake eaten at a wedding party, usually covered with icing and with several layers
a dress that a woman wears at her wedding, especially a long white one
